text.tspan: Net imports of natural gas per capita, 1980 to 2024
Net imports is calculated as total imports minus total exports. This includes all forms of dry natural gas, including
liquefied natural gas (LNG). Vented and flared gas are not included. A negative value indicates that a country
Data source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (2026); Population based on various sources (2024)
